messages:
Priya: Quick sync on the joint HW perf/W + throughput playbook. Want reproducible numbers and a short public blurb + a detailed partner appendix with kernel diffs.
Lukas: Yes. Primary metrics: tokens/sec, watts (host+board), latency p50/p95, and tokens/joule. Secondary: PCIe utilization, memory bandwidth.
Jordan: Proposed bench matrix (trimmed): models=[Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B], quant=[fp16, int8], seq=[4k, 12k], batch=[1,16]. Add an "app-sim" chat mix for context.
Intel Eng: We can provide reference runs on Gaudi/our accelerators and a kernel patch for our fused ops. Will also attach RAPL config for host power if needed.
NVIDIA Eng: We'll run H100S and A800. NVML sampling at 250ms recommended for fine-grained power curves. We'll share kernel tweaks and a microbench harness.
Priya: Repro steps must include: OS image (AMI/container), driver versions, kernel git commit or patch file, and exact bench script + seeds.
Lukas: Small example run command we use for CI:
```bash
# quick-bench.sh
MODEL="$1"; SEQ="$2"; BATCH="$3"; QUANT="$4"
./rdb_bench --model $MODEL --len $SEQ --batch $BATCH --quant $QUANT --warmup 50 --measure-power --steps 600 --power-sample-ms 1000
```
Jordan: We'll add a separate step to capture cold-start (no kv) vs warm KV steady-state. Also capture event traces for kernel-level hotspots.
Intel Eng: For kernel tuning try: hugepages=512, swapoff, irqbalance=off, and our fused-op micro-op reordering patch. We'll submit a PR with patch + perf counters.
NVIDIA Eng: We'll validate kernel patch impact and report delta in % throughput and % tokens/J. Also include CI artifact with raw CSVs for transparency.
Priya: For the public claim marketing wants a concise headline (e.g., "X tokens/sec at Y W on H100S"), with footnote linking to partner appendix and methodology. Legal signoff required before publishing.
AWS BD: I'll own marketplace badge/legal coordination. Need final numbers 10 business days before publish. Keep phrasing conservative.
Benchmark Bot: New scheduled job: joint-bench-1755032222 on perf-cluster-7, est runtime 8h, status: pending. :rocket:
Lukas: Action list: @Intel Eng & @NVIDIA Eng -> produce kernel diffs + driver/firmware matrix by Wed; @Jordan -> bench scripts + app-sim harness by Tue; @AWS BD -> legal kickoff; @Priya -> blog skeleton + partner appendix template.
Jordan: Will push scripts to infra repo and include a README with exact commands, env vars, and a small parser for tokens/sec and power curves. PR by EOD Tue.
Intel Eng: We'll include RAPL/NVML mapping notes and a short how-to for external power meters. Also attach a CSV with board-level sensors.
NVIDIA Eng: One more: please include a short reproducible test (5-minute chat replay) to show real-world jitter under load. We'll run it as part of validation.
Priya: Good. Let's reconvene Fri 9am PT for an interim check. I'll add meeting note and link to the repo once Jordan's PR is up. Thanks! :handshake:
